findings.highlight: I go by the park and put my brakes on.
findings.evidenceJa: 公園を通りかかって、ブレーキを引いた。
findings.governingReading: The active source begins with Shirou stopping the bicycle; the preceding park/braking narration is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores obsolete narration and changes the active scene text.

findings.highlight: groceries still in the bicycle cart
findings.evidenceJa: 買い物袋を籠にいれたまま
findings.governingReading: The groceries remain in the bicycle basket when Shirou enters the park.
findings.explanation: The basket again becomes a cart, changing the concrete staging.

findings.highlight: Inside the park I passed, thinking that it would be nice if I could meet her again… …Is the figure of a silver-haired girl.
findings.evidenceJa: 思いつきで寄り道した公園には、ぼんやりと立ちつくす、銀髪の少女の姿があった。
findings.governingReading: In the park Shirou detoured through hoping to meet her, a silver-haired girl stands vacantly.
findings.explanation: The inverted English is ungrammatical and obscures the payoff to Shirou’s self-described whim.

findings.highlight: Illya is standing there absent-mindedly, not doing anything.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは何をするでもなく、ぼんやりと立っている。
findings.governingReading: The active source begins with Illya not noticing Shirou; the preceding description is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores deleted narration as active text.

findings.governingReading: The active source contains Shirou calling Illya’s name but comments out the narration explaining that he calls to her.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores deleted narration and duplicates the already enacted speech action.

findings.highlight: She must have been really surprised, as Illya is looking at me with wide open eyes.
findings.evidenceJa: よっぽど意外だったのか、イリヤは目を見開いて俺を見ている。
findings.governingReading: The active source leaves Illya’s surprise in her voiced reaction; the explanatory gaze narration is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores an obsolete physical and emotional explanation.

findings.highlight: Illya stops moving. Her eyes look directly into mine.
findings.evidenceJa: ぴたり、とイリヤの動きが止まった。
findings.governingReading: Both the sudden stillness and direct gaze are commented out in the active Japanese witness.
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates two deleted reaction lines, supplying staging absent from the source.
